text_block_list.text:
—The Japan Cup. Neo Universe had 
previously made a premature challenge 
against Senior-class Umamusume at the 
Takarazuka Kinen, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe, huh... It's been a while. 
This time—we're even.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Haha! I hope your mood's gotten better 
alongside your running!

I was set for a rematch against the rivals 
I fought back then. However, it was not to 
be under clear skies...

Due to the rain from the day before, the 
track is heavy.

Neo Universe didn't dislike wet tracks at 
all. In fact, she excelled on them, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Heavy track... Heavy track...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A track that's perpetually heavy... That 
means—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. Or perhaps 
in the UK...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Overseas racecourses... There was a plan. 
—After the "GATE."

Mutterings like a broken, intermittent 
signal. What caught my attention was the 
phrase "after the GATE."

Yes, Neo Universe made a promise. That 
once the race is over, she'll talk about 
her "future prediction" after the "GATE."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, my dream is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: My dream... didn't... come true.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Racecourses are universal. However—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: And there— there—was—

I reflexively stopped her. It felt as 
though Neo Universe's spirit was freezing 
over before my very eyes.
choice_data_list: Focus on the race for now.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Races. ...Affirmative. That's... right.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A Senior mixed race... Before, it was deep 
space. But today is different...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: This is—Neo Universe's sector of space.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S... Tap Dance City... A 
"rendezvous"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if our paths will intersect. 
That's why—

Neo Universe returned from her drift 
through thought. She decided to leave 
everything until after breaking through 
this barrier.
